start: A gym member on Settings with the internet on

user_sees: Page 'Help and feedback' with 'Ask a question and get an answer at once. Or tell us what works, what is hard, or what you want next. Tap Speak and talk, or type.'
A box 'Type here, or tap Speak', a greyed 'Send', the card 'Your questions'
must_not: Send enabled with an empty box

steps.action: Type 'How do I change kg to lb?' and tap 'Send'
user_sees: 'Sending. The answer usually takes a few seconds.'
The question in 'Your questions' at once with 'Waiting for the answer. It usually takes a few seconds.'
must_not: Two messages from a double tap
The typed text cleared before it was taken

user_sees: A 'Quick answer' (automatic) with 'Answer written by AI from our help pages.' and 'Did this solve it?' 'Yes' 'No'
must_not: An answer to another member's question

user_sees: 'Got it. We reply as soon as we can.' and 'The MettleUp team will reply here.'
must_not: The question marked solved

start: A gym member on 'Help and feedback'

steps.action: Tap Speak, allow the microphone, say the feedback
user_sees: The spoken words typed into the box; privacy line 'Only the recording is sent.' ... 'The text reaches us only if you tap Send.'
must_not: Anything sent before Send is tapped
The recording kept

user_sees: 'Thanks! We read every message.'
must_not: The message sent marked as typed when it was spoken (input 'voice' is sent)

start: A gym member with the round feedback button on, on any screen

user_sees: The feedback sheet for that screen
must_not: The button covering a main button with no way to move it

steps.action: When the MettleUp team has replied, open the app
user_sees: 'The MettleUp team answered you' with 'See your questions and answers' and 'Ask something new'
must_not: The same reply announced twice

steps.action: Tap the phone alert 'The MettleUp team answered your question' - 'Tap to read the answer.'
user_sees: 'Reply from the MettleUp team' marked 'New' in 'Your questions'
must_not: An alert for a reply already read

user_sees: 'What changed in the last 3 updates. Tap a button to try a change.' and the list, each change with a button
must_not: Changes of a version newer than the one installed
A button that opens a screen the member cannot use

user_sees: Rows 'Credits', the exercise database credit and 'MettleUp' with the version
must_not: A wrong version

user_sees: Screen 'Credits' - 'Pictures and fonts made by others', 'Thank you to the people who share their work freely.' and one card per credit
must_not: A licence link that does not open

user_sees: Its web page in the browser
must_not: The app crashing when no browser opens

start: A gym member on 'Help and feedback' when things go wrong

user_sees: Send stays greyed out ('Write something first.')
must_not: An empty message sent

user_sees: 'Couldn't send. Check your internet and try again. Your message is still here.'
must_not: The message lost
'Thanks! We read every message.' for a failed send

steps.action: Send with 'Add my watch's screen log' on when the log fails
user_sees: 'Your message was sent, but the watch screen log was not. Try again later.'
must_not: The member's message sent twice

steps.action: Refuse the microphone and tap Speak
user_sees: A plain reason and typing still works
must_not: A prompt on every tap
A crash

steps.action: Open 'What's new' on a version with no entries
user_sees: 'Nothing new to show yet.'
must_not: An empty card

start: A gym member with one question answered and one waiting

user_sees: The answered one with its answer; the waiting one with 'Waiting for the answer...'
must_not: A waiting question shown as answered

user_sees: 'Great! Glad it helped.' and 'You said this solved it.'
must_not: The choice asked again

steps.action: A team reply arrives for the other one
user_sees: It shows with 'New'; after reading, no 'New'
must_not: 'New' staying after reading

steps.action: Turn 'Show the feedback button on every screen' off
user_sees: The round button gone from every screen
must_not: The button back after the app restarts

start: A gym member whose gym uses MettleUp, sending a help question

user_sees: The message goes to MettleUp with the app version, phone model, screen and the gym's code
must_not: The gym owner or trainers reading the help question
The member's phone number sent with it

user_sees: Only the recording is sent to turn speech into text
must_not: The recording kept by MettleUp or the speech service
